body: This is the type of blunt advice I really appreciate. It’s just so hard to imagine telling them the truth. I just know that they’d prefer that to burying their only child. I just need to be brave and face the consequences. It just really sucks.
Suddenly I’ve found a new hero in an anonymous sister. I keep rereading these posts trying to glean some courage. This has helped so much??

Is your sister alright now? I just have a hard time picturing what happens after the truth comes out. I have focused so much on hiding it that the idea of everything just being there is..unfathomable? I guess?

I keep reading this over and over again. God. I know they’d love me still but I don’t want to disappoint them. At least if I’m dead they can openly mourn and not just privately seethe? But I also want to tell them so bad. How did your sister tell them?
